mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500 thousand units signal a deteriorating housing market that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production below 105.0 and unemployment rate above 4.0 signals an economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 680,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above 680,000.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 295.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 295.0.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth above 150,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 150,000.

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1550.0 and RSAFS < 680000.0.
